scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @flowpay/web && npm run build --workspace @flowpay/api
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/accounting/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/provider-contract/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/provider-simulation/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/provider-circle-wallets/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build --workspace @flowpay/web && npm run deploy:check
